limitations: Fixed P/E/D + full512x43 shared linear head is worse than the stored parent on both primary MSE and MAE in this development V; it is cheaper on CPU2. This is a conditional predictor diagnostic, not proof that Bolt is universally needed.
Parent B2 remains one-selected-epoch LIMITED_SCREEN; the fixed no-Bolt head receives three A60 epochs. Optimization sufficiency, other heads, and predictor-specific P/E training remain unresolved.
Parent full-V148 accuracy is reused from its original saved inference and exact old audit; new CPU parity covers six origins. A full CPU148 re-evaluation is not claimed.
The same V148 has been used for development. Seed or new code does not make it independent unseen generalization.

This reviewer independently recomputes public sufficient-statistic aggregation and timing arithmetic, and checks exact opaque byte bindings; raw numerical arrays and model tensors are not loaded here.
The worker performed a separate full saved-V FP64 rescore. Public-statistic arithmetic review is not described as another checkpoint forward or another full-array rescore.
Cost stage probes are intrusive and kept separate. Ratios are observed whole-pipeline CPU2 latency ratios for these exact artifacts/batches, not speed claims across devices.
Eight observed completed PeMS worker windows and PID/create_time trees are checked. Absence of unrelated host activity or unobserved reparented processes is not independently proven here.
CPU memory fields and sampled process peaks have different meanings; active_adapter_MiB in the original API counts GPU bytes and must not be read as zero CPU adapter memory.
Pre-T numeric parsing is asserted by the pinned streaming-loader receipts; opaque compressed-file SHA/ZIP I/O can touch protected byte ranges without converting their numeric values.
